purpose: Verify current external standards and reliable-processing patterns before implementing the Book parent Runtime V2, while preventing a useful interchange standard or cloud pattern from becoming accidental canonical authority or unnecessary implementation dependency.

verified_sources.name: JSON Schema
verified_sources.verified_fact: JSON Schema 2020-12 remains the current published specification baseline on the project specification page.

verified_sources.name: OpenAPI Specification
verified_sources.verified_fact: OAS 3.2.0 is the latest published OpenAPI specification and describes language-agnostic HTTP API interfaces.

verified_sources.name: CloudEvents
verified_sources.verified_fact: CloudEvents lists v1.0.2 as the latest stable core specification, with working drafts maintained separately.

verified_sources.name: IETF HTTPAPI Idempotency-Key
verified_sources.verified_fact: The latest Datatracker record is revision -07, latest revision 2025-10-15, but the document is expired and archived rather than an RFC.

verified_sources.name: AWS Transactional Outbox Pattern
verified_sources.verified_fact: Atomic persistence of domain state plus an outbox record prevents dual-write inconsistency; duplicate delivery requires idempotent consumers and ordering must be preserved when material.

verified_sources.name: Azure Transactional Outbox Pattern
verified_sources.verified_fact: The pattern commits business state and its events atomically, then relays committed events separately; idempotent processing and ordering remain explicit concerns.

decisions.decision: Use JSON Schema 2020-12 semantics as the external schema baseline for any formal Runtime V2 envelope schemas/validators. The executable Runtime may perform deterministic direct validation without adding a runtime package dependency, but schema meaning must not contradict the 2020-12 baseline.
Do not bind Runtime V2 core to HTTP or OpenAPI. If a future Book HTTP adapter is authorized, describe that adapter using current OpenAPI rather than changing internal canonical/runtime semantics.

Keep internal intake/admission/outbox records Book-owned. A future external event publisher may project committed outbox entries into CloudEvents 1.0.2, but CloudEvents identifiers/attributes never replace Book ledger identities or transaction receipts.

Do not cite or implement the expired Internet-Draft as a normative Book dependency or RFC. Retain the already-designed internal principles of unique idempotency keys, normalized-request fingerprinting, same-key/different-payload rejection and reconciliation after unknown outcomes because they independently satisfy Book reliability requirements.

Represent parent-visible side-effect publication as append-only outbox records written in the same logical transaction as Runtime V2 intake/proposal/receipt state. Publish/relay is downstream and cannot partially commit Book state. Consumers must tolerate replay/duplicate delivery by stable event identity.

Do not turn Runtime V2 into a full CQRS or event-sourcing platform. Immutable proposal snapshots, receipts and outbox entries are sufficient for this bounded runtime objective; adding a second event-store authority would duplicate the Book parent ledger.

No cross-service multi-datastore compensating transaction is required by the current Runtime V2 core. Re-evaluate only if a later implementation actually coordinates independent durable Book-external writes that cannot be handled by parent transaction plus outbox/inbox boundaries.

implementation_constraints: Runtime V2 core remains transport-neutral and provider-neutral beyond Registry V2 classes.
No new first-class System Master system is created by adopting an interchange or cloud pattern.
No external schema/event/API standard becomes canonical Book state or admission authority.
State mutation plus admission receipt/outbox creation must expose all-or-nothing logical transaction semantics.
Replay and duplicate notification must be safe under stable identities.
Runtime V2 must remain testable deterministically without cloud vendor dependencies.
qualification_effect: NONE. This research artifact permits bounded Runtime V2 implementation but is not executable evidence, A-01 qualification, author approval, publication authority or production standing.
